column5: What to do

Remove singular service phrasing from title, H1 and headings; link to the homepage with the anchor "website maintenance services".

Owner of "website maintenance services", "website maintenance company/agency", "web maintenance services". Put "Website Maintenance Services" in the title and H1 and point every internal link with these anchors here.

Keep for "small business" queries only (ranks #4–6 there). Remove generic "website maintenance services", "affordable website maintenance" and "website maintenance packages" from title/H1; link to the owners.

Same packages intent. Merge and 301.
